messages.subject: Minor International | Global growth, sustainability and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Minor International Leadership Team,

Minor International's global operating footprint requires leaders who understand how corporate strategy translates into country relationships, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution. That is the core of my current role.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I work across ministries, regulators, communities, strategic partners and internal functions on operating, investment and reputation-sensitive matters. I also bring energy-transition and carbon-governance experience, giving me a wider responsible-business perspective beyond traditional corporate affairs.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, regional or international mandates in Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or country leadership. I have attached a Minor International-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the appropriate senior team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
